text:
amy.harper: Heads-up: ACME deal — they're moving from POC to committed (50k/mo). We need an ops-ready capacity plan that covers steady throughput, predictable burst handling, and a clear pricing example. cc @sam.kim @kai.chen @vijay.ram

sam.kim: Got it. Do we have a traffic profile? steady vs peak, payload sizes, SLOs?

amy.harper: Sales doc: steady 250 RPS, expected two 5-min spikes to ~1200 RPS/day. Avg response ~80 tokens. SLOs: 95% < 300ms TTF, 99% < 600ms overall. They want open-13b-quant.

kai.chen: For 80-token avg, KV-cache + batching matter a lot. Quick back-of-envelope: 250 RPS * 80 tokens = 20k tokens/s. open-13b-quant throughput depends on GPU type, but without cache ~200 tokens/s per GPU (conservative).

kai.chen: With continuous batching + KV cache we often see 2-3x effective throughput for chat workloads. Rough proposal: reserved pool ~40 GPUs, autoscale/burst up to 80 for spikes. Need a bench to validate.

vijay.ram: Operational notes: reserve across 2 AZs for HA. Autoscale policy suggestions: scale_up step=+8 GPUs, scale_down step=-4 GPUs, cooldown 10m. Provide 15m preheat window for KV warmup and use burst credits for instant headroom. Also confirm KMS/BYOK options for Private deployments.

amy.harper: Pricing question from deal desk: how do we bill bursts vs reserved? can we give a worked example they can show finance?

sam.kim: Billing model: reserved = flat monthly fee (capacity commitment). Bursts beyond reserved billed per-GPU-hour at metered rate. I'll draft a worked example with numbers. Recommend a 3-month ramp with checkpoints (telemetry gating) to avoid surprises.

kai.chen: Autoscale policy config (draft):
```
autoscale_policy:
  reserved_gpus: 40
  max_gpus: 80
  scale_up_step: 8
  scale_down_step: 4
  cooldown_s: 600
  burst_credit_minutes: 90
  preheat_minutes: 15
  kv_warm_keys: 100
```

vijay.ram: Security Qs: customer sent a security questionnaire. Key asks: VPC peering for private traffic (supported via Private), BYOK/HSM (Private supports BYOK; hosted uses our KMS but we can do cross-account key policies), SOC2 + HIPAA addendum requested. Looping in Legal/Compliance. Also need to confirm audit log retention for the committed contract.

amy.harper: Action items: sam -> pricing example and sample invoice numbers; kai -> run bench for open-13b-quant with their profile and report perf numbers + recommended reserved count; vijay -> confirm AZ HA config + security answers for SCCQ. I'll compile and send to ACME tomorrow EOD.

sam.kim: :thumbsup: ETA EOD tomorrow. I'll include an example showing reserved 40 GPU cost + burst metered cost for 10 spike-hours/month.

deploy-bot: bench job queued (job-id: 2026-03-22-1145). Link: https://infra/bench/2026-03-22-1145

amy.harper: Perfect. If bench validates, propose reserved=40 GPUs monthly, burst_to=80, preheat 15m, and a 3-month ramp with telemetry gates. Will include escalation path if latencies regress. :rocket:
